title: Sea-CLIP: Mining Semantic-Aware Representations for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection with CLIP
uses_multiple_visual_encoders_evidence: This feature interacts with pairs of key and value features, derived from concatenated visual features from CLIP and DINOv2 encoders. | Fig.1 caption: an Anomaly Matching Decoder (AMD) is introduced to transform representations from CLIP and DINOv2 into an anomaly localization mask.
evidence_location: Sec.3.2.2 Anomaly Matching Decoder；Eq.8 (K=phi'(CONCAT(Fq,Sq)), V=phi'(CONCAT(Fq,Sq)))；Fig.1；Fig.3；CVF 版页脚页码 3690、3693
feature_fusion_mechanism: 双视觉分支并行（DINOv2 分支出语义对应 S-match 掩码 Ms；CLIP 分支出纹理掩码 Mt）-> AMD 交叉注意力匹配解码器：q=phi(CONCAT[qs,qt])（Ms/Mt 对 CLIP 特征 Fq 加权池化），K/V=phi'(CONCAT(Fq,Sq))，3 个 Transformer encoder block，Sigmoid 输出精修掩码 M1；最终 M 取 M0 与 M1 的调和平均
score_level_fusion_evidence: harmonic mean between M0 and M1 ... y = y0 + MAXPOOL(M)（Sec.3.3 Inference，页脚页码 3694）；Tab.4b 第2行 WS（learning two weights for combining Ms and Mt，PRO 88.95->89.91）即为分数级融合基线
reference_bank_evidence: 单一参考集（参考图 Ir）被两分支共用：RA constructs a reference memory bank, i.e., R, via collecting patch-wise features of Ir（Eq.7，bank 仅由 CLIP 特征 f^r 构成），S-match 则直接使用同一参考图的 DINOv2 特征 Sr；不存在按分支的独立 bank
joint_evidence: Eq.5 (s*,t*) = arg max_{s in W, t in H} <sr_{s,t}, sq_{i,j}> 由 DINOv2 选出参考 patch 行，Eq.6 ms_{i,j} = 1/2 (1 - <f r_{s*,t*}, f q_{i,j}>) 用 CLIP 在该共享行打分 => J 型（跨分支共享最近邻行）；Eq.7 mt_{i,j} = min_{r in R} 1/2 (1 - <f q_{i,j}, r>) 为 CLIP 独立最近邻 => L 型。两种模式同文共存于 Sec.3.2.1 Patch Matching Module（页脚页码 3693）
normal_sample_budget: N = 1/2/4 shots（Sec.3.1: 只取 N (N<=4) 张正常样本训练或建库；Sec.4.1: N samples of each category are available during the training, with N = 1, 2, 4）；另用 SD1.5 为每张参考图生成 150 张异常图
weight_search_or_learned_weights: learned（AMD 与线性层 phi/phi'、可学习 prompt token 端到端训练，learning rates of 0.05 and 0.002 for AMD and learnable tokens；Tab.4b 的 WS 变体亦为 learning two weights for combining Ms and Mt）；未见权重搜索
interaction_evidence: 非因子化设计，但在两种融合机制下分别测出加入 DINOv2 分支的收益：Tab.4b 行1 baseline(仅 CLIP)=88.95 PRO、行2 WS(附加 DINOv2 分支+学习权重)=89.91、行3 AMD(1 T-block)=91.72；原文：This simple method achieves 0.96% higher PRO score than baseline / an AMD using a single Transformer encoder block helps obtain 1.81% higher PRO。Tab.3 行1(RA only)95.20/88.95 vs 行2(SM+RA)96.10/90.03 分离出语义分支贡献
closest_to_current_work: 最接近本文的既有工作：J 型（DINOv2 选参考行、CLIP 在该行打分）与 L 型（CLIP 独立最近邻）在同一切片内共存，并用 Tab.3/Tab.4b 分别度量，但没有把匹配模式作为第二因子与新增表征分支交叉（无交互项、无多种子）
earlier_claim_supported: refuted（早前 no multi-RGB-encoder fusion 的说法被推翻：Sea-CLIP 明确同时使用 CLIP 与 DINOv2 两个视觉编码器，并在 AMD 中拼接二者特征）

title: Revisiting Multimodal Fusion for 3D Anomaly Detection from an Architectural Perspective
venue_year: arXiv 2024 preprint (arXiv:2412.17297v1)；abs 页未标注会议或期刊
uses_multiple_visual_encoders_evidence: MFN consists of three types of independent modality-specific modules (MSMs), and it aims to fuse these multimodal features from MRN in a two-level manner. | MRN restores abnormal images (from AG) to normal ones and then extracts multi-scale features, which can be divided as early features, middle features and late features
evidence_location: Preliminaries（Architecture Skeleton / MSM Structure）；Fig.2；Revisiting 3D-AD Fusion Architecture（Impact of Inter-module / Intra-module Fusion）；Tab.4；Fig.4(a)
feature_fusion_mechanism: 两级架构搜索：intra-module 融合单元（EFAC/MIFC/LAFC），候选算子含 addition、concatenation、GLU、guided attention，架构参数 alpha_ex、alpha_in、beta_op 用 DARTS 式连续松弛学习；inter-module 层搜索 early/middle/late MSM 的组合方式
score_level_fusion_evidence: 正文描述的融合均发生在特征/模块层；未找到在多分支分数上做显式加权或求和合并的公式。最接近的表述为 Intra-module Fusion 中的 employing multiple fusion operations is more beneficial ... the guided attention operation and weighted summation operation show best effectiveness in 3D-AD tasks（指特征层算子）
shares_reference_bank_across_branches: not_verified（该方法不使用 memory bank 或参考集）
reference_bank_evidence: it benefits from the fact that our method uses neither memory-bank-based strategies that increase memory nor large pre-trained language models that affect inference speed
joint_evidence: 全文无测试样本与参考样本之间的最近邻检索环节；异常判别由 ADN（Multimodal Reconstruction Network + Anomaly Discrimination Network 的重构/判别范式）完成，不是 embedding matching / memory bank 范式
normal_sample_budget: 主实验为完整训练集；few-shot 研究用 5/10/50 images（we randomly select 5, 10, and 50 images on Eyecandies and MVTec 3D-AD datasets as the training set），见 Table 6、Table 7
weight_search_or_learned_weights: searched/learned（NAS：架构参数 alpha_ex、alpha_in、beta_op 由梯度搜索优化）
interaction_evidence: Tab.4 给出不同 early/middle/late MSM 组合下的逐类 I-AUROC；正文：combining three MSM modules ... a 9.8% improvement over the early MSM, and a 3.0% improvement over the middle MSM / when early MSM is combined with middle MSM, the performance is improved by 7.7%；Fig.4(a) 比较 Late/Early/Middle/Hybrid 融合类型。理论：Proposition 1 给出 b^g_m >= b^max_l 条件下融合新增 opinion 才保证不降，结论称 fusing an additional opinion ... has great potential to boost the model's accuracy；the above fusion may lead to accuracy deterioration, but even this is limited under mild conditions
closest_to_current_work: 最接近的既有研究：在同一张表内把新增表征分支/模块的收益在不同融合配置与融合算子下分别测出，并给出条件性理论（新增分支收益依赖条件）；但研究对象是 3D-AD 的模块级融合架构，不涉及共享或独立的参考最近邻行

title: Commonality in Few: Few-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection via Hypergraph-Enhanced Memory
uses_multiple_visual_encoders_evidence: We use two pretrained feature extractors: DINO (Caron et al. 2021) for extracting 2D image features, and PointMAE (Pang et al. 2022) for extracting 3D point cloud features.
evidence_location: Method / Overview；Fig.2（并列显示 2D Memory Bank 与 3D Memory Bank）；Semantic-Aware Hypergraph Construction；Hyperedge-Guided Memory Search；Experiments Tab.1、Tab.2；Appendix 实现细节
feature_fusion_mechanism: 双分支各自建 bank（2D 用 DINO 的 768-d patch 特征；3D 用点云 3,7,11 层拼接的 1152-d 特征）；用 RGB 特征构建的超图结构 H 统一服务 2D 与 3D 两个模态，做结构引导的记忆采样（SGMS）与检索（Bi-TF-MP 联合超图免训练消息传递 + HGMS 超边引导两阶段最近邻搜索）
score_level_fusion: partial（仅模块内分数组合已明确；跨模态分数合并未给出公式）
score_level_fusion_evidence: we retain the conventional patch-level search method that directly compares test sample node features with memory bank node features. The resulting scores are element-wise multiplied with A to obtain the final anomaly scores.（Sec. Hyperedge-Guided Memory Search）=> 模块内两路检索分数相乘；2D 与 3D 两支最终分数如何合并正文未见公式，故跨模态部分为 未核实
shares_reference_bank_across_branches: no（bank 按模态独立；但超图结构跨模态共享）
reference_bank_evidence: Fig.2 并列画出 2D Memory Bank 与 3D Memory Bank；we uniformly use hypergraphs constructed from RGB image features to support the subsequent modules in both the 2D and 3D modals.（Sec. Semantic-Aware Hypergraph Construction）
joint_evidence: 各模态在自己的 bank 内做最近邻：Aij = min_{m in Msub_i} ||X^test_ij - m||^2（Eq.5）；共享的是 RGB 构建的超图结构 H 而非最近邻参考行；论文未比较共享最近邻行与各分支独立最近邻
normal_sample_budget: K = 1/2/4 shots（Tab.1 的 1-shot、2-shot、4-shot）；超图默认 |E|=4（MVTec 3D-AD）/8（Eyecandies），采样率 0.1
weight_search_or_learned_weights: 无权重学习或搜索（方法为 training-free：Bi-TF-MP 免训练；超参 alpha=0.9、L=1、k、|E| 由实验选定，未学习分支权重）
interaction_evidence: 消融为逐项累加（Tab.2：SGMS 68.6 -> SGMS+HGMS 71.7 -> +Bi-TF-MP 72.0 I-AUROC），另有超边数、alpha、L 的敏感性分析（Fig.6），但无新增表征分支与匹配模式的交互实验
closest_to_current_work: 最接近本文的共享/独立问题：用一张由 RGB 特征构建的超图结构同时引导两个模态各自独立 bank 的检索（结构共享 + 最近邻独立），但未把该设计作为可对照条件，也未测量新增分支收益随匹配模式的变化
